---
title: "The Thread of Higher Knowledge"
date: 2026-11-27
tags: [knowledge, perception]
---

There always seems to be a thread of higher knowledge hanging above us. We can climb it and operate at a higher level of abstraction.

I have been developing an interest in cinematography. A movie is no longer only a story. I notice the composition, the movement of the camera, the use of light, and the choices made in withholding information from the viewer.

The same movie, viewed by the same person at two points in their intellectual life, becomes two different experiences.

The world does not need to change for one's experience of it to change.

Knowledge increases the resolution at which one experiences reality.

I could drink coffee every morning for the next forty years. Or I could gradually understand its origins, the differences between beans, and the process that turns them into what I taste.

The physical act remains largely the same. The internal experience becomes richer.

Occasionally, climbing one thread of knowledge brings several others into view that were previously invisible.

Perhaps living a richer life is as much about increasing one's capacity to experience things as it is about increasing the number of things one experiences.

Not merely seeing more of the world, but seeing more in it.
